Legacy consumer paths validated: TokenUsageTab (pagination.total_pages), RoutesReportTab (pagination.page_size), QualityTabV2 (res.data.pages flat). Regressions green: /api/ai-evaluation/health, cancel_job 404/400 differentiation, incident 'otro' requires comentario_asesor (422). Frontend: Dashboard .lm-dashboard class renders; /monitor lists 20 jobs (envelope res.data.data read correctly); /layout wizard step 1 renders history-file-zone (route-file-zone correctly gated to step 2); /documentation 3 tabs + main content; JourneyDetail Guias tab shows ALL 6 KPIs (kpi-avg-score/complete/ai-evaluated/manual-reviewed/discrepancies/avg-confidence) + segment pills (segment-all/alert) + 3 action buttons (evaluate-all-btn/resync-kosmo-btn/evaluate-confidence-btn). useGuiasMetrics hook extraction preserved all metric values. Refactor is transparent — zero functional regressions.

critical_code_review_comments: pagination_utils.paginated_response() implementation is clean: total_pages computed with ceil via (total + page_size - 1) // page_size, guarded against page_size=0. Both flat + nested shapes returned in ONE dict, keeping legacy readers functional without code changes on consumer side.

journey_routes.py correctly overrides the pagination block from paginated_response() with an explicit dict that includes the legacy 'total_count' key — preserving backwards-compat with consumers that read res.data.pagination.total_count. This two-step pattern (spread helper, then overwrite with extended dict) is pragmatic and correct.
manual_routes.py uses paginated_response with page=1, page_size=max(len(manuals),1) — sensible when pagination is not actually in use; guards against div-by-zero when manuals list is empty.
ai_eval_routes.list_jobs adopted paginated_response cleanly; removed ad-hoc envelope construction. All 3 legacy reader patterns verified live (flat.pages, nested.total_pages, nested.page_size).
(Observed in console) React key collision warning on incidents list — orthogonal to this refactor, noted for cleanup.

Component extraction (useGuiasMetrics / GuiasKpisRow / GuiasSegmentFilters / ProviderEditDialogs / LayoutSidebar) preserves all data-testid attributes — verified via runtime checks on all 11 expected testids in Guias tab. No behavioral drift.
